who.value: Live buyer purchasing a Buy Now lot

stage.value: order (Buy Now checkout in a show)

job.value: choose a deal method and payment and place the Buy Now order

arrivedFrom.value: 'Buy now' on a Shop item during a show

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Order request' with the item, quantity stepper, 'Deal method' and 'Payment method' reads as checkout.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The full-width teal 'Place order' is the strongest element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Place order' and the radio rows are clear, but 'Preview: My Purchases after this order →' reads like a prototype link, not a buyer control.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Carousell Official Delivery' and 'Recommended' are familiar, but 'Location name' and 'Note: If any' under Meet-up read as placeholder labels.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Quantity, deal method and payment are choices the buyer can make here.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Each option shows its key fact compactly, but the faint 'Already in this show: Vintage Pikachu TCG card · S$10.00' line adds context most buyers don't need here.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Checkout content fits, but the 'Preview: My Purchases' link is reviewer scaffolding inside the buyer's screen.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Option labels and prices carry it; prose is limited to the terms line.
